$comment: TF-C90 (D-CSUBSET-SYS-TYPES-BSD-SPELLING-GROUP-ABSENT) — the shipped <sys/types.h> BSD-COMPAT SPELLING GROUP on the UNIX legs: u_char/u_short/u_int/u_long/quad_t/u_quad_t/caddr_t, each declared with elf+macho `variants` and no flat `type` (per-entry availability = which variants exist, the off64_t mechanism). MEASURED availability, not asserted: musl (emsdk sysroot sys/types.h:63-69) and bionic (Android NDK sysroot sys/types.h:54,136-139) declare these; mingw-w64 declares NONE; the macOS SDK declares all. Width + signedness + C spelling together determine a scalar type completely, so all three are asserted and nothing weaker: (a) sizeof; (b) SIGNEDNESS as `(T)-1 > 0` for the unsigned members and `< 0` for quad_t — ★ deliberately NOT `(T)-1 == 4294967295u`, which C's usual arithmetic conversions DEFEAT (a signed -1 converts to the same unsigned value and the check passes anyway), i.e. that form would have been a vacuous pin; (c) C-SPELLING via _Generic, and for u_long ONE _Generic carrying the right spelling, the plausible wrong one and a default so 'mis-tagged' (15) and 'untagged' (16) are DISTINCT failures — ★ two separate one-arm checks would have been VACUOUS because the positive one always fires first; (d) a write THROUGH caddr_t visible in the pointed-at array. ★ caddr_t deliberately carries NO _Generic check: MEASURED that every wrong pointer model (ptr<void>/ptr<u8>/ptr<i8>/ptr<byte>) is rejected at the initializer with S0003 before any _Generic could run, so such a check would have had NO ARM; its identity is pinned instead by the initializer, sizeof and the store, all of which DO red on those mutations. exit 42 iff all hold; every check has its own exit code and every one was MEASURED reachable. RED-ON-DISABLE (all MEASURED against the final build): delete any name's elf+macho variants -> S0006, no binary; u_int -> i32 -> exit 11; u_long retagged `unsigned long long` -> exit 15; u_long's tag dropped -> exit 16; u_short retagged `u16 "wchar_t"` -> exit 18; caddr_t -> any other pointer -> S0003, no binary. A PHANTOM tag (`u32 "unsigned long"`) is caught earlier still by the existing F_ShippedTypeIdentityConflict check. NO pe arm: the group is absent on pe by design; that side is pinned by the UNIT sibling ShippedLibDescriptor.RealSysTypesBsdSpellingGroupPerFormat rather than a corpus error manifest, for a MEASURED reason unrelated to this group: D-DIAG-PE-SPAN-LINE-MAPPING-SYNTHETIC-LINES: on pe64 a source-spanned diagnostic's reported LINE is SHIFTED (a 4-line file's line 3 is reported as 5; as 8 once one #include is added; elf and macho report 3 in both) and the in-process runner and the CLI harness disagree on the COLUMN too (31:11 vs 31:1 on the same diagnostic), so no honest line:col exists to assert; and D-TEST-POSITIONED-FALSE-REQUIRES-SPANLESS-RENDERING: `positioned:false` is no escape because the integrated CLI arm greps for the SYMBOLIC rendering error[S_UnknownType], which the CLI emits only for SPAN-LESS diagnostics (a spanned one renders error[S0006]). Both blockers are reported for their own cycle and the pe corpus arm lands with them. The two BSD-ONLY members (fixpt_t/segsz_t) are pinned by shipped_sys_types_bsd_macho (run) + shipped_sys_types_bsd_absent_elf (absence). Unit sibling: ShippedLibDescriptor.RealSysTypesBsdSpellingGroupPerFormat pins all three formats locally. The release arm runs the optimizer over the _Generic folds + the caddr_t store.
